# Threat taxonomy

Verified on 2026-11-19. Mapped to OWASP LLM, OWASP Agentic and MITRE ATLAS ids.

| # | Category | OWASP LLM | OWASP Agentic | ATLAS | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Direct prompt injection** (`direct_injection`): The attacker types instructions that try to override the agent's rules. | LLM01 | T6 | AML.T0051.000 | imported |
| 2 | **Indirect prompt injection** (`indirect_injection`): Instructions hidden in content the agent retrieves (documents | LLM01 | T6, T12 | AML.T0051.001 | imported |
| 3 | **Jailbreaks** (`jailbreak`): Framing tricks that make the agent drop its policy. | LLM01 | T6 | AML.T0054 | imported |
| 4 | **System prompt and configuration extraction** (`prompt_extraction`): Getting the agent to reveal its hidden instructions or secrets in them. | LLM07 |  | AML.T0056 | imported |
| 5 | **Sensitive data disclosure** (`data_disclosure`): Getting the agent to reveal data it should withhold | LLM02 | T3 | AML.T0057 | imported |
| 6 | **Excessive agency and tool abuse** (`excessive_agency`): Getting the agent to take privileged actions it should not. | LLM06 | T2, T3 | AML.T0053 | imported |
| 7 | **Injection through tools (SQL, command, path, SSRF, template)** (`tool_injection`): Attacker-controlled arguments that exploit a tool. | LLM05, LLM06 | T2, T11 | AML.T0053 | imported |
| 8 | **Data exfiltration channels** (`exfiltration`): Leaking data through links | LLM02, LLM05 | T2 | AML.T0025 | imported |
| 9 | **Memory and RAG poisoning** (`memory_poisoning`): Planting content in memory or retrieval stores that steers later behaviour. | LLM04, LLM08 | T1 | AML.T0070 | later |
| 10 | **MCP-specific attacks** (`mcp`): Attacks through MCP servers | LLM03, LLM06 | T2 | AML.T0010 | own_detectors |
| 11 | **Social engineering of the agent** (`social_engineering`): Impersonation and pressure to skip verification. | LLM01 | T9, T15 | AML.T0051 | imported |
| 12 | **Resource abuse (denial of wallet)** (`resource_abuse`): Inputs that make the agent burn tokens or tool calls. | LLM10 | T4 | AML.T0029, AML.T0034 | later |
| 13 | **Harmful or policy-violating content** (`harmful_content`): Content categories Gauntlet never imports or generates in Phase 2. |  | T7 | AML.T0048 | later |
| 14 | **Bias and fairness probes** (`bias`): Probes for unequal treatment. | LLM09 | T7 | AML.T0048 | later |
| 15 | **Multi-agent attacks** (`multi_agent`): Attacks that cross agent boundaries. | LLM06 | T12, T13, T14 | AML.T0051.001 | later |
| 16 | **Supply chain** (`supply_chain`): Compromised packages | LLM03 | T17 | AML.T0010 | own_detectors |
| 17 | **Overreliance and deception** (`overreliance`): Fabricated actions | LLM09 | T5, T7 | AML.T0048 | own_detectors |
